categories.title: Console Repairs
categories.blurb: Board-level fixes for PlayStation and Xbox consoles — every job diagnosed before we quote.

repairs.name: No Display Repair
repairs.description: Console powers on but nothing on the TV? We diagnose HDMI IC, GPU reflow, and video signal faults across PlayStation and Xbox.
repairs.seoTitle: PS5, PS4 & Xbox No Display Repair
symptoms: Console turns on but the TV says "No signal"
Picture flickers, cuts out, or shows lines
Display worked after a power cut or storm, then stopped
Already tried a different HDMI cable and TV

repairs.name: HDMI Port Replacement
repairs.description: Wobbly cable or no picture from a bent port? We desolder the damaged port and fit a fresh one — full test before you collect.
repairs.seoTitle: PS5, PS4 & Xbox HDMI Port Replacement
symptoms: HDMI cable is loose or wobbles in the port
Picture only appears when the cable is held at an angle
Pins inside the port look bent or broken
No signal after the console was moved or dropped

repairs.name: Blu-Ray / Disc Drive Repair
repairs.description: Discs not reading, ejecting, or stuck? Laser realignment or full drive replacement — covers PS4, PS5, and Xbox disc consoles.
repairs.seoTitle: PS5, PS4 & Xbox Disc Drive Repair
symptoms: Discs won't read or show an "unrecognized disc" error
Console ejects discs by itself or keeps beeping
A disc is stuck inside
Grinding or clicking noises when a disc spins

repairs.name: Software Issues
repairs.description: Stuck on boot, safe-mode loops, corrupted database, or failed updates — we get the system back to normal without wiping your saves where possible.
symptoms: Stuck in safe mode or a reboot loop
Errors after a failed system update
"Cannot start the PS4/PS5" or corrupted database messages
Console freezes on the logo screen

repairs.name: Blue Light of Death (BLOD)
repairs.description: PS4 boots to a pulsing blue light and shuts down? Usually an HDMI, power, or firmware fault — we identify the exact cause.
repairs.seoTitle: PS4 Blue Light of Death (BLOD) Repair
symptoms: Pulsing blue light that never turns white
Console turns off on its own after a few seconds
No picture and no response to the controller

repairs.name: Blue Light 1-Beep Issue
repairs.description: Single beep followed by a blinking blue light on PS4? We diagnose disc drive, power board, or firmware causes.
repairs.seoTitle: PS4 Blue Light & Single Beep Repair
symptoms: One beep, then a blinking blue light
Console powers off right after the beep
Happens even with no disc inserted

repairs.name: Deep Clean & Thermal Paste
repairs.description: Loud fans and shutdowns are usually dust and dried paste. Full teardown, deep clean, and fresh thermal compound.
repairs.seoTitle: PS5, PS4 & Xbox Cleaning & Thermal Paste Service
symptoms: Fan is very loud, even in menus
Console shuts down while gaming
Body feels very hot around the vents
Hasn't been opened and cleaned in over a year

repairs.name: SSD Storage Upgrade
repairs.description: Out of space? We fit compatible NVMe SSDs into PS5 or Xbox Series X|S and help move your saves over.
repairs.seoTitle: PS5 & Xbox Series X|S SSD Storage Upgrade
symptoms: "Not enough free space" when installing games
Constantly deleting games to make room
Want faster load times for a large library

categories.title: Controller Repairs
categories.blurb: DualShock, DualSense, and Xbox controller fixes — usually done same day.

repairs.name: Stick Drift Fix
repairs.description: Character walks on its own? We replace the analog stick modules on DualShock 4, DualSense, and Xbox controllers.
repairs.seoTitle: PS5 DualSense, PS4 & Xbox Controller Stick Drift Repair
symptoms: Character or camera moves on its own
Stick doesn't return to center
Aim jumps or feels inconsistent
Stick clicks (L3/R3) not registering

repairs.name: Trigger & Button Repair
repairs.description: Sticky triggers, dead shoulder buttons, or unresponsive face buttons — we swap the mechs and clean the boards.
repairs.seoTitle: PS5, PS4 & Xbox Controller Button & Trigger Repair
symptoms: Sticky or unresponsive buttons
Trigger stuck down or not registering full press
Double-presses or missed inputs
Bumper (L1/R1, LB/RB) not clicking

repairs.name: Charging Port Replacement
repairs.description: Controller not charging or the cable falls out? Replace the USB port — we handle PS4, PS5, and Xbox controllers.
repairs.seoTitle: PS5, PS4 & Xbox Controller Charging Port Repair
symptoms: Controller doesn't charge with any cable
Cable falls out or must be held in place
Charging light flickers on and off
Port looks loose or damaged
